legacy_code.cell_revision: 7c1d432 uses minimage 0.1.2; src/mic.rs uses Cell fractional wrapping for rgsaddle band internals

rows.cause: The rejected independent check included fixed slab atoms and used a custom radius-2 lattice-image search; the benchmark uses free atoms only and minimage 0.1.2's Smith/Minkowski-reduced 27-image Euclidean convention. The legacy harness passes raw stored positions directly to minimage::Cell::displacement_euclidean through the C ABI, performs no ASE get_distances call, explicit wrapping, centering, or alignment, and computes sqrt(mean(per-atom squared 3D displacement)) over free atoms. For ase-neb it compares the reference with the highest-energy interior image selected from the final unconverged band. All rounds are identical because ASE BFGS starts from the same linear band without a seed and deterministically reaches the same final selected structure; each run stores that structure independently.
